subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and product-wide explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this as memory-plugin and channel-plugin work?
rationale: The request crosses memory authority, storage/API shape, workspace precedence, plugin boundaries, and group-channel reply semantics, so a small autonomous bugfix would choose product policy by accident.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Use this issue to define the durable rule authority and multi-bot reply contract before implementation.

options.title: Split narrower fixes
options.body: Move Feishu dropped-reply bugs to the existing Feishu issues and open a separate memory-governance design item.

options.title: Plugin-first rule surface
options.body: Require the durable rule capability to prove itself through memory or channel plugin APIs before adding core behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define the durable rule authority and multi-bot reply contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available owner signal for the cross-cutting product boundary between memory, channels, and Feishu behavior.
